name: Vividly Strange
source:
Blair is prone to hallucinations, fearlessness (okay, more like carelessness), and bad logic. Which is the cocktail that lands him with... well... whatever Adamo is. Through the eyes of Blair, you experience the strangest night of his life - including his new "friend"/hallucination (he's not sure)...

[From [URL=http://renai.us/game/vividlystrange.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/URL]]
